description.p: PCBCraft is an open-source electronics design application for editing schematics and PCB layouts.
Draw schematics, assign footprints and edit boards in a shared project. The application also includes a command-line interface and an MCP server.
This community package is maintained independently of Tangency Labs. It installs the upstream Linux build.

Project folders in Documents are accessible by path. The desktop file chooser uses a portal. To open projects by path elsewhere in your home directory, run flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.tangencylabs.pcbcraft.
The package runs without network access or access to coding agents installed on the host.
